277017744.description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.

Jewelry metal content and stones have not been tested unless explicitly stated, and stones have not been individually inspected. Items sold in lots have not been counted or sorted and may contain small or damaged pieces. Returns are not accepted for these items.

276966592.description:
Collector Assembled
Mineral and Gemstone Specimen Collection
Natural Minerals and Polished Stones in Display Cases
Dimensions: Large Case 14.5" x 8.5" x 2"; Square Case 8" x 8" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This comprehensive mineral collection features two distinct display formats containing a variety of raw and tumbled geological specimens. The square shadowbox presents twelve raw specimens, each identified with gold-toned labels, including varieties such as Jadeite, Sodalite, Amethyst, and multiple forms of Quartz. The larger briefcase-style display case contains twenty-four recessed compartments, most housing individual clear containers for smaller tumbled stones and crystal points, ideal for educational study or decorative display.
Includes twelve labeled raw specimens: Guava Quartz, Jadeite, Orange Calcite, Aragonite, Sodalite, Amethyst, White Quartz, and Rose Quartz
Larger professional-style display case features a textured faux-leather exterior with glass viewing lid and dual latches
Square 8x8 shadowbox frame includes a wall-mounting hanger and a slotted top for additional collection storage
Total weight of collection is 5.8 pounds
Condition:
Good overall condition. The mineral specimens are well-preserved and secure in their mounts. The large briefcase case shows moderate surface wear and scuffing to the black finish on the underside, but latches and hinges function correctly. The square shadowbox is in very good condition with minor handling wear.
